documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V3.0: PET-CF
Bambu PET CF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701T01
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility
PET-CF / PPA-CF / PPS-CF / PA6 CF Carbon Fibers Filament Usage Guide

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (Mechanical Properties, dry state); the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 35 ± 5 MPa, elongation 2.4 ± 0.8 %, bending modulus 2210 ± 180 MPa, bending strength 49 ± 5 MPa, impact 4.5 ± 0.6 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT come from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 4730 ± 260 MPa, Z 2160 ± 170 MPa), melt index (25.3 ± 2.5 g/10 min at 280 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (130 °C, DSC 10 °C/min), heat deflection temperature 205 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.37% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), retraction length (0.8 - 1.4 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (45 - 60 °C), max overhang angle (~ 70°), max bridging length (~ 30 mm), spool material (PC + ABS, temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing of prints (80 to 140 °C, 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows.

The TDS recommended chamber temperature (45 - 60 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting. The PET-CF wiki's suggested maximum volumetric flow (8 mm³/s) is not written to motion.max_flow, a printer key, for the same reason.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: product name "Bambu PET CF", model "T01-xx", CLP "Not classified", the section 8 carbon-fibre handling warning (gloves when loading/unloading, cutting or sanding), and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO-TI / IATA) transport. Its section 8 reads "carbon fiber-reinforced filament （Glass fiber-reinforced filament)", a wording slip in the SDS. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreements kept for review: nozzle temperature (TDS 260 - 290 °C vs material-table wiki 260 - 300 for the PET-CF/GF class); bed temperature (TDS 80 - 100 °C, agreed by the material-table glue table, vs the material-table plate table 80 - 120 ℃ on the Engineering Plate and 100 - 120 ℃ on the Smooth PEI / High-Temperature and Textured PEI plates). The product TDS values are kept.

Printer guidance: the PET-CF wiki says "Compatible with all Bambu Lab 3D printers"; the material-table wiki rates PET-CF/GF "Not Recommended" on open-frame printers and "Recommended" on enclosed printers. "Not recommended" is not "not compatible", so only the compatible_with family relation is written. The Bambu Cool Plate / PLA Plate is "Not recommended" (material-table wiki), not "not compatible", so no relation is written for it.

AMS: the store page ("All AMS Series NOT Compatible"), the PET-CF wiki ("AMS series not compatible") and the material-table wiki ("Not Compatible") agree for feeding. The AMS HT is still named for drying and sealing only (PET-CF wiki 2.3; AMS HT 80 °C for 12 h); the AMS 2 Pro cannot dry it ("Not compatible" in the drying wiki).

Marketing prose proves no number: "Very Low Moisture Absorption", "Exceptional Mechanical Properties", "High Dimensional Stability", "Exceptional Thermal Resistance" and the page-builder sections ("In saturated water absorption conditions, the strength and stiffness of PET-CF have small losses"; the 70 °C / 150 °C oven comparison, whose text also mentions PLA deforming near 155 °C) are not stored as values; their charts are images.
No hex: the store page links no hex-code document for this filament and none is cached, so its only colour value "Black (71100)" has no published hex.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/54b1c5ae4f094655b838bb1f45f58453.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published.
The PET-CF wiki links its own TDS and MSDS copies ("TDS- PET-CF", "MSDS- PET-CF"); they were not cached and not read. The store-linked TDS V3.0 and SDS SDS20260701T01 were read.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 6); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.

The store FAQ (4.Safety Tips) and the PET-CF wiki say the filament is not food-grade / not food-contact grade, is highly moisture-absorbent, and may carry hard microscopic splinters (wear puncture- and cut-resistant gloves and safety goggles); no registry key holds these.
